entries.complaint: Corners pop off overnight because pocket depths aren't standardized, the elastic is only at the corners, and toppers or adjustable bases add height or bend the mattress
entries.redesign: Elastic sewn all the way around the hem, plus a measured pocket depth printed on the label with a 'fits mattress X–Y in.' range that includes toppers

entries.complaint: The insert slides and bunches inside the cover overnight, because nothing holds it in place and insert and cover sizes don't match
entries.redesign: Snap tabs at all four corners and the middle of each edge on every insert and cover, with matched sizes labeled 'insert fits cover X'

entries.complaint: Getting the insert into the cover is a two-person job unless you know the 'burrito' trick, because both far corners have to be held at once
entries.redesign: A cover that zips open on three sides and lies flat like a sandwich, so the insert is laid in and zipped closed with no turning inside out

entries.complaint: Fiberfill pillows come out of the wash lumpy and flat even when the care tag is followed, so many people stop washing them
entries.redesign: Fill sewn into several baffled chambers so it can't migrate, inside a zippered washable outer shell, so the cover is washed often and the fill rarely

entries.complaint: Foam mattresses sag into body impressions within a few years, and warranty claims fail on high depth thresholds
entries.redesign: A zippered case with separate comfort layers that can be rotated or swapped, plus a printed foam-density spec and a sag gauge in the box
entries.prior_art: Mattresses with replaceable or flippable comfort layers

entries.complaint: Memory foam traps body heat and sleepers wake up sweaty, even on models marketed with cooling gel
entries.redesign: An open-cell or coil comfort layer with side vents, plus a tested 'sleeps warm / neutral / cool' rating on the label instead of 'cooling gel' marketing

entries.complaint: Clock displays and charging lights are too bright for a dark room, and dimming offers only two or three still-bright steps, so people tape over them
entries.redesign: A warm red or amber display that dims smoothly to fully off, shows the time on a tap, and has charging lights that switch off once the room is dark

entries.complaint: Thin particle-board or cardboard drawer bottoms bow and fall out, and runners stick or let drawers drop onto each other
entries.redesign: Plywood drawer bottoms seated in a groove on all four sides, with metal ball-bearing slides as standard even on flat-pack dressers
